statements.statement: The policy pays for a hire car of similar size.
statements.quote: we pay for a hire car of similar size

statements.statement: The daily cost of the hire car is up to $40.
The policy covers this for no more than 14 days.
The policy covers this while the vehicle is off the road for repairs after a covered collision.
statements.quote: While the vehicle is off the road for repairs after a covered collision
